name: geenee
description: Geenee: drive a genome workspace by chatting. One page beside the conversation holds the igv genome browser, the Juicebox Hi-C contact-map viewer and the Spacewalk 3D chromatin viewer. Search ENCODE/4DN, load maps, tracks and 3D ensembles, navigate genes and loci, compare, share. Connects to the Aiden Lab's hosted MCP server; nothing runs locally.
